title: Differential order of a linear map between algebra modules
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $C$ a commutative $R$-algebra with its structure map $R\to C$ [def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient]. Let $M,N$ be $C$-modules, regarded as $R$-modules by restriction of scalars. For an $R$-linear map $T:M\to N$ and $c\in C$, its scalar commutator is the $R$-linear map $[T,c]:x\mapsto T(cx)-cT(x)$. Define recursively, for $n\in\mathbb N$, that $T$ has differential order at most $0$ if $T$ is $C$-linear, and that $T$ has differential order at most $n+1$ if $[T,c]$ has differential order at most $n$ for every $c\in C$.
